mentions.name: Lumos Builder
mentions.description: An AI web app builder that generates application code and automatically sets up a Postgres database (via Neon), making it easier to get started and enabling large complex apps that require auth and a database, while also handling simple websites. Built on Next.js with easily exportable and viewable code, and powered primarily by Claude Sonnet 3.7 and Gemini Pro 2.5 with other models selectable.
mentions.problem: AI web app builders typically don't set up a database for you, making it harder to get started and to build large complex apps that require auth and a database.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a web app builder that generates code via AI, much like hundreds of other tools out there. The differentiator is that the tool automatically sets up a Postgres DB (using Neon) for you. So, it's a lot easier to get started and it can handle large complex apps that require auth and database, but it can also build simple websites.
